For a day that may take you from work to lunch, this women's navy blouse has a boxy fit. The fabric is linen. Its familiar shape is simple to wear with pieces already in your wardrobe.

The simple silhouette leaves room for patterned separates or a quieter tonal combination. Wear it on its own or beneath an open layer when the day calls for one.

Styling note - Try it with off-white shorts and sandals for a casual afternoon. Straight-leg trousers and loafers offer a second option for dinner or meeting friends. Keep the rest of the outfit uncluttered, with a simple bag and just a few accessories.
